page.layout: One page of text, centred. A decorative fleuron rule at the top. Below it a heading in capitals and roman, then a poem in italic with a large initial O at the left, in six stanzas of four lines. Two small printed marks ("»") stand in the left margin beside verse lines. The signature is set right, below the poem.

main_text.head: AD ILLVSTREM ET INCLYTVM DOMINVM, D. ALBERTVM Co-mitem in Hanavv & Rinnegk, Do-minum in Mintzenberg.

p.i: OMNIBVS incumbit fidei confeßio verę, Munia in hoc mundo qualiacunq; gerant. Sive Magistratus hi sint, cives q; gubernent, Christiadum pascant sive docendo gregem.
Sive colant artes alias: doctive rudésve: »Qui sunt in Christo, sunt velut unus homo. Inprimis autem perspecta ea dogmata sunto, Quæ fundamentum religionis habent.
Et quæ Romanus tentat subvertere præsul, Qui sævi Satanæ vimq; vicesq; gerit. Quale est de CHRISTI VERBO, quod sufficienter Tradit Apostolicus fatidicusq; Canon.
Hoc Papa impugnat, nobisq; imponere gestit Traditionum ingens barbaricumq; jugum. Contra hoc pugnamus, Thesibusq; renitimur istis, Quas omnes Codex approbat ille sacer.
Inscriptasq; tibi, COMES INCLYTE, mente benigna Suscipe, sint tenues exiguæq; licet: Ad Christi laudem faciunt tamen, atq; tuentur Dogmata quæ in nostris sunt celebrata Scholis.
Perge, COMES GENEROSE, Deoq; bonisq; probari, Inq; tuo, CHRISTI, pectore, crescat amor. »Qui CHRISTVM IESVM rectè cognoscit amatq;, »Ille tenet veræ prosperitatis iter.

main_text.p: Amandus Polanus á Polansdorf S. Theologiæ D.

page.notes: No page number, running head, catchword or signature mark is printed. The fleuron rule at the top is decorative and not transcribed. The "»" marks in the left margin are printed typographic marks beside lines 6, 23 and 24 of the poem; they are given as notes. "Do-minum" is hyphenated at the line end in the heading as printed. The initial O is a large woodcut-style letter; it is joined to the first word. The signature is set right-aligned and is written as a plain paragraph. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout.
